title: Tandoori Chicken Skewers
description: A classic Indian dish featuring marinated chicken grilled to perfection. The combination of warm spices and crunchy vegetables creates a delightful fusion of flavors.

ingredients.name: tandoori masala
ingredients.notes: available at most Indian grocery stores

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, tandoori masala, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, and lemon juice.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the chicken, onion, bell pepper, and cucumber onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot with basmati rice or naan bread.
